absent: Full entry signature, preparation and first half of shrink_folio_list before writeback triage, including isolation guarantees and initial list state.
Definitions, flag values and accounting layouts for scan control, reclaim statistics, node state, folio state and translation unmap options.
Contracts and side effects of referenced but unseen helpers for paging out, unmapping, reference checking, demotion migration, throttling, filesystem entry and deadlock prediction.
Memory layouts and lifetime rules for folio, address space, swap device, cluster, swap input output context, memory group and vector structures.
Locking, ordering and sleep rules for folio guard, page table guard, mapping operations, batch draining and deferred split handling beyond visible guards.
Numeric values for cluster size, huge page thresholds, node and memory group event identifiers and pager outcome enumerations.
Failure, retry and concurrency semantics for folio splitting, swap charge, discard synchronization and synchronous writes beyond branches shown.

findings.text: Reclaim driver consumes an isolated folio collection with scan context, node and statistics, separates freed pages from survivors, adds demoted pages to reclaimed total, drains batched frees with memcg discharge and translation flush, submits pending swap output, splices survivors back to input and returns total reclaimed pages.

Writeback triage has three steady outcomes. Congested daemon context with reclaim already marked and node writeback flag set counts immediate pressure and reactivates. Healthy throttling or missing reclaim mark or unsafe filesystem entry or deadlock prone mapping marks reclaim and reactivates while continuing scan. Remaining legacy memcg case drops folio guard, blocks until writeback clears, requeues same folio and retries.

Reference disposition is skipped when references ignored, otherwise a check selects reactivation, retention with keep accounting, or continuation toward reclaim. When a previously large folio is observed small after split, scanned accounting is reduced by the surplus and the batch size is reset to single before further handling.

Optional demotion diverts eligible folios to a separate collection and releases their guard when migration support allows the size. After the main scan, migration is attempted once, successes are added to reclaimed and demoted counters, failures are spliced back, non proactive scans retry them as ordinary reclaim without demotion while proactive scans leave them queued.

Anonymous swap preparation requires input output allowance and absence of pinning. Large folios require exclusive references apart from isolation and may split when partially mapped with deferred work pending. Small allocation failure reactivates, large failure splits then retries with fallback accounting, success forces dirty state to cover races where freed memory lost dirty tracking but kept swap backing.

Mapped folios are offered for unmapping with batched flushing plus extra handling for huge mappable shapes and synchronous table acquisition for large sizes. Persistent mapping counts unmap failure and reactivates, with a separate count when non swap backed becomes swap backed through lazy free failure. After unmapping, possible pinning reactivates to protect pinned pages and underlying filesystem metadata from reclaim.

Dirty handling diverges by cache type. File cache dirty is counted for immediate reclaim, ensured marked for reclaim and reactivated without writing here. Other dirty requires safe filesystem entry and write permission, otherwise retained. Allowed cases flush potentially writable translations then delegate to a pager with keep, activate, synchronous success with relock and revalidation, and clean continuation outcomes.

Release capable folios attempt buffer release and reactivate on failure. Mapping less single reference folios are freed through a zero test, with a speculative reference race counted as reclaimed without list membership. Lazy free folios freeze at single reference and count separately. Other cases require removal from mapping, otherwise retained. Freed folios accumulate in a batch that discharges memcg and flushes on full and at end.

Activation path reclaims swap space for cached folios when swap is full or the folio is locked, asserts inactivity, then sets active state for unlocked folios with separate file and anonymous accounting and memcg activation events. Retention path releases guard and queues to survivors while asserting absence of list and unevictable markers. Final activation totals are aggregated and emitted as a single event.

Dirty marking clears the reclaim marker when a mapping is present to avoid confusion with readahead after writeback races, then delegates to the mapping dirty operation and returns its outcome. Mapping less folios use a fallback path.
Mapping less dirty helper reports no change when dirty already set, otherwise transitions from clear to set and reports a change.
Writeback waiter remains in a loop while the writeback marker is set, emitting a trace with the current mapping each iteration and sleeping on the writeback bit until observed clear.

Swap output completion ignores empty contexts. Otherwise it records an event, delegates to the device submit operation and clears stored device and input output state. An alternate header form provides an empty operation for configurations without swap.

Swap slot allocation in stub form always reports invalid input. Full form expects locked and up to date state, declines large requests when huge swap is disabled and declines oversize requests beyond cluster capacity, tries a fast path then a slow path under a per cpu cluster guard with a discard retry for single pages, charges memcg and removes from cache on charge failure, reports memory exhaustion when not cached and success otherwise.

Swap cache removal locks the cluster covering the entry offset, delegates table removal, unlocks and drops references for the folio page count. The middle layer adjusts file page and swap cache statistics after table work. The table worker validates identity and state, walks the covered span replacing entries with supplied shadow state, clears stored entry and cached flag, frees fully unused ranges or singly frees unused slots when partly still referenced. A header alternative is empty.

Swap fullness reports true when global swap is full. When memory plus swap accounting is active or the folio carries no charge it reports not full. Otherwise it walks ancestors toward the root under a read guard and reports full when doubled usage reaches configured high or maximum thresholds.

Statistic update resolves node and owning group under a read guard. Untracked folios without a group update only the node counter. Tracked folios update the vector belonging to their group on that node.

Cluster guarding derives the cluster by quotient of offset over cluster size with swapoff liveness and bound checks, resolves device state by type with a swapoff check, composes entry to cluster through those steps and derives intra cluster position by remainder. Acquisition requires task context and live users then takes the cluster spin guard with optional interrupt masking, a plain wrapper covers the common case, release unlocks. A no swap build supplies null lookup and empty unlock.

Folio guard must be held for swap fullness testing, swap allocation and cache table removal. Read side guarding spans ancestor walks and vector resolution. Reclaim releases folio guard before blocking on writeback and requeues the same folio for retry. Swap cache mutation is confined outside interrupt context and coordinated with the swap map.

Reclaim tolerates a race where setting reclaim meets end of writeback and could be misread as readahead, preferring to ensure a later wait that avoids memory exhaustion. Redirtying clears reclaim to avoid disturbing readahead ramps. Large unmapping uses synchronous table acquisition to avoid skipping transiently cleared entries. Forced dirtying covers raceless clearing of dirty versus swap backing in freed anonymous memory. Buffer only freeing tolerates speculative references. Blocking on writeback is avoided without filesystem or input output allowance and for deadlock prone mappings.

Table removal preconditions require a locked cached folio not under writeback whose entry maps to the supplied cluster. Per slot counts distinguish still referenced entries from freeable ones, stored swap value is zeroed and cached state cleared, fully unreferenced ranges are freed together while partially referenced ranges free only unreferenced slots.

Cluster sizing bounds large swap allocation: requests larger than one cluster are rejected as invalid, intra cluster position is the remainder of offset over cluster size and cluster selection is the corresponding quotient.
